solution: In 6 years the interest is 3 times the sum (the rate is 50%). To become 7 times itself the interest must be 6 times the sum, which takes 6 × 6/3 = 12 years.
questionHi: कोई राशि साधारण ब्याज पर 6 वर्ष में 4 गुनी हो जाती है। उसी दर पर वह कितने वर्ष में 7 गुनी हो जाएगी?
solutionHi: 6 वर्ष में ब्याज राशि का 3 गुना है (दर 50%)। 7 गुनी होने के लिए ब्याज राशि का 6 गुना होना चाहिए, जिसमें 6 × 6/3 = 12 वर्ष लगेंगे।

question: The simple interest on ₹90,000 is ₹14,400. The rate of interest per annum (in %) and the time (in years) are equal. What is the rate?
solution: SI = P × R × R ÷ 100, so R² = 14,400 × 100 ÷ 90,000 = 16. R = 4% (and the time is 4 years).

question: A sum was lent at simple interest for 3 years. Had the rate been 1% higher, it would have earned ₹960 more. What was the sum?
solution: The extra 1% for 3 years is 3% of the sum. 3% of the sum = 960, so the sum = 960 × 100 ÷ 3 = ₹32,000.
